nl.statement: A finite labeled vertex population \(V=[d]\) with \(d\ge2\), a labeled directed acyclic graph \(G\) on \(V\) with edge set \(E=E(G)\), parent and child maps \(\operatorname{Pa}_G,\operatorname{Ch}_G\), strictly positive innovation rates \(\mu\in(0,\infty)^V\) and strict edge thinning probabilities \(\alpha\in(0,1)^{E}\). Innovations \(\varepsilon_i\sim\operatorname{Pois}(\mu_i)\) and edge-and-individual trials \(B_{ijr}\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(\alpha_{ij})\) are mutually independent, the thinning operator is \(\alpha_{ij}\circ x=\sum_{r=1}^{x}B_{ijr}\), and the observed counts solve \(X_j=\varepsilon_j+\sum_{i\in\operatorname{Pa}_G(j)}\alpha_{ij}\circ X_i\), with observational law \(P=\mathcal L(X)\) on \(\mathbb N_0^V\). All generating functions are formal series in the indeterminates \(z=(z_v)_{v\in V}\): the root-cluster polynomials \(H_i\), the log probability-generating function \(\Psi_P\), its exact-support coefficients \(c_k\) and the degree-four signature \(t_4(P)\). No faithfulness, no edge-strength margin, no compact parameter box and no lower bound on \(p_0\) are imposed. — WORLD DISPOSITION (corrected in round 2): `define-local`. No existing declaration packages this world. The local packaging is the `def:strict-pb-class` structure `StrictPBSCM G μ α P` (Basic.lean), which bundles the Poisson innovations, the Bernoulli thinning array, the structural recursion, the strictness clauses and the observational law \(P=\mathcal L(X)\); the strict-generation predicate is its abbreviation `IsStrictLaw`. `Causalean.DAG` is reused for the GRAPH COMPONENT ONLY (labeled DAG carrier, `parents`/`children`/`isRoot`/`topoOrder`/`descendants`), together with `Causalean.Graph.AcyclicConstruct.DAG.ofAcyclic` and `Causalean.Graph.MarkovEquiv.CoveredReversal.DAG.flipEdge` for graph construction and covered-edge reversal; it hosts no probabilistic or parametric content, so it cannot carry the S-block. World-level search trace (re-runnable): `grep -rE 'Poisson|thinning|branching|INAR|Galton' ../Causalean` → only `Stat/FiniteRaoBlackwell/PairedPoissonHistogram/*` (a paired-Poisson histogram risk calculation, no DAG/branching recursion) and no thinning operator; `grep -rE '^(structure|class) .*SCM' ../Causalean/SCM/Model` → `Causalean.SCM` / `Causalean.SCM.Model` generic structural-equation layers over arbitrary value spaces with no ℕ-valued additive thinning or innovation-law parameterization; Mathlib side `lean_leansearch "Poisson distribution probability mass function measure"` → `ProbabilityTheory.poissonPMF`/`poissonMeasure` (reused inside the local structure) and `"Bernoulli distribution PMF probability measure boolean"` → `PMF.bernoulli` (likewise); no bundled branching-process/PB-SCM world exists in either library. Encoding (process, not reader-facing): `V` is `[Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]` with `hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card V`; `G : Causalean.DAG V` (../Causalean/Graph/DAG.lean); \(\operatorname{Pa}_G,\operatorname{Ch}_G\) are `DAG.parents`, `DAG.children`; sources are `DAG.isRoot`; reverse-topological recursion uses `DAG.topoOrder` + `DAG.topoOrder_lt` as the well-founded measure. \(\mu,\alpha\) are `V → ℝ` and `V → V → ℝ` with the strictness conditions imposed only on edges (E1). Counts and multi-indices are `Cell V := V →₀ ℕ` (E2). Series live in `MvPowerSeries V ℝ` (E3). Fiber members are Boolean edge functions (E4). \(S(P),F(P)\) are `SimpleGraph V` and \(\mathcal T_0(P)\) is a `Finset` of `SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent` (E5). Ambient-hypothesis rule E8: being generated by \(\mathcal M_d^\circ\) is part of this world, not a per-node hypothesis.

Observational sampling from the law of S1: \(n\) independent draws \(X^{(1)},\dots,X^{(n)}\) of the complete labeled count vector from one fixed law \(P\) on \(\mathbb N_0^V\), a nominal error probability \(\eta\in(0,1)\), the finite low-count cell index \(I_4=\{x\in\mathbb N_0^V:|x|\le4\}\) with population cell probabilities \(p_x=P(X=x)\) and empirical frequencies \(\widehat p_x=n^{-1}\sum_{b\le n}\mathbf 1\{X^{(b)}=x\}\), the simultaneous radius \(\epsilon_n\), the truncated cell region \(Q_n\), the rational cell-to-coefficient map \(T\), the coefficient region \(C_n\), the outward-inverted graph set \(\mathcal D_n\) and the certified outward-inversion handle \(\mathsf A_{\mathrm{out}}\). There is no designated treatment and no overlap condition; in particular \(p_0\) is not bounded away from zero. — Encoding: `S : Causalean.Stat.IIDSample Ω (Cell V) μ P` supplies `S.Z : ℕ → Ω → Cell V`, independence, identical distribution and `μ.map (S.Z 0) = P`; \(\widehat p_x\) is `S.sampleMean (fun y => if y = x then 1 else 0) n`, so `Causalean.Stat.Concentration.hoeffding_abs_ge` applies verbatim with `a = 0`, `b = 1`. \(I_4\) is `Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Cell V => x.sum (fun _ m => m) ≤ 4)` (finite because `V` is finite). The union bound is Mathlib's `measure_biUnion_finset_le` over `I_4`.

review.note: Unfolding thin gives the finite Bernoulli thinning sum in the pointwise structural equation; its measurability and success-mass clauses merely make the α-parameterized thinning notation explicit, while joint independence is supplied by the separately stated branching-law assumption.

review.note: branchingCoordinate indexes exactly the innovation coordinates and edge-trial array, and mutual independence plus the Poisson singleton masses and Bernoulli success masses is equivalent to the displayed product law on the surrounding probability space.

nl.statement: \(\mathcal M_d^\circ=\{(G,\mu,\alpha,P):G\text{ is a DAG on }V,\ \mu\in(0,\infty)^V,\ \alpha\in(0,1)^{E(G)},\ P=\mathcal L(X),\ \text{ass:structural-recursion and ass:independent-branching-law hold}\}\)

review.note: Nonempty BranchingWitness unfolds to a probability space carrying measurable X, the structural recursion and independent branching law, with P equal to the law of X; mu_pos and alpha_strict exactly impose the stated strict parameter domains.
On the finite DAG, rootClusterAux at card V is the unique stabilized reverse-DAG expansion of the displayed child recursion, and the second component is exactly the formal-series sum μ_i(H_i-1).
On the intrinsic positive-zero-mass domain, logPGFSeries is the formal log of PGF/P({0}), hence equals Ψ_P−Ψ_P(0); coeff and signature are exactly c_k and its restriction to 1≤|k|≤4.

nl.statement: \(\Gamma_i(k)=\{\gamma:\gamma\text{ is a finite open-edge descendant genealogy rooted at }i\text{ with observed-label multiplicity }k\},\quad w_\gamma=\prod_{e\in O_1(\gamma)}\alpha_e\prod_{e\in O_0(\gamma)}(1-\alpha_e)\)

review.note: Genealogy paths encode finite rooted, prefix-closed open-edge descendant occurrences, multiplicity counts repeated terminal labels by path occurrence, and the nested product assigns α to included child paths and 1−α to excluded trials exactly as w_γ.
Filtering Boolean edge relations by acyclicity and existence of μ, α, and StrictPBSCM is equivalent to the labeled-DAG fiber; StrictPBSCM supplies exactly μ>0 and edgewise 0<α<1.

SimpleGraph.fromRel enforces distinct endpoints and symmetrizes the positive pair-coefficient relation, which is already symmetric because unitCell i + unitCell j is commutative, exactly matching unordered two-element subsets.
The three pairwise inequalities are equivalent to |{i,j,k}|=3, and the product-positivity and both degree-three/four coefficient alternatives are transcribed exactly.

nl.statement: \(A(P)=\{i\to k:\exists j\in V,\ \mathsf{Head}_P(i,j;k)\},\quad M(P)=\{k:\exists i,j\in V,\ \mathsf{Head}_P(i,j;k)\},\quad F(P)=S(P)\setminus\{\{i,k\}:i\to k\in A(P)\}\)

review.note: The two Finset filters are exactly A(P) and M(P), while SimpleGraph.fromRel symmetrizes the ordered arrows and graph difference removes precisely their underlying unordered edges from S(P).

On the source-forest domain, componentRoot selects the unique M(P)-anchor when present and otherwise the supplied in-component root; distance increase orients each residual tree away from that root, and extending ρ to anchored components is conservative because those values are ignored.

On the source-edge domain, the covered-edge witness is intrinsic to constructing the flipped DAG, and the graph flip, two changed rates, reversed thinning value, and all otherwise clauses agree exactly.

Unfolding decodeMu, decodeAlpha, and decodeBeta gives the displayed β, α, and μ equations; for a finite DAG the fuel 2·|V| exceeds the alternating child-depth propagation needed to realize the reverse-topological recursion.

nl.statement: \(\mu_s=6,\ \mu_m=2,\ \mu_r=1,\ \alpha_{sm}=2/3,\ \alpha_{sr}=1/2,\ \alpha_{mr}=1/2\) on \(s\to m\to r\) and \(s\to r\), for each choice of sink \(r\) among three labels

review.note: The pairwise-distinct Fin 3 parameters enumerate exactly the labeled transitive triangles, triangleEdge gives precisely s→m, s→r, and m→r, and the total parameter maps are the zero-extension of the stated edge parameters with μ_s=6, μ_m=2, μ_r=1 and α_sm=2/3, α_sr=α_mr=1/2.

On the stated domain 1 ≤ |k| ≤ 4, finsuppAntidiag with the nonzero filter enumerates exactly the ordered nonzero decompositions of k, and every referenced cell has degree at most four; the extra coordinates of Lean's total-function carrier are conservative and do not affect the stated map.

nl.statement: \(\epsilon_n=\sqrt{\log(2|I_4|/\eta)/(2n)},\quad Q_n=\{q:q_x\ge0,\ \sum_{x\in I_4}q_x\le1,\ q_0>0,\ |q_x-\widehat p_x|\le\epsilon_n\ (x\in I_4)\},\quad C_n=\{T(q):q\in Q_n\}\)

review.note: After unfolding cellRegion, cellRadius, lowCells, and cellToCoeff, Lean imposes exactly q_x ≥ 0, the truncated mass bound, q_0 > 0, the simultaneous epsilon_n intervals, and takes their image under T; unrestricted carrier coordinates conservatively extend the I_4-indexed vectors.

Unfolding fiberAtSignature and coeffRegion gives exactly the union over t ∈ C_n of acyclic labeled graphs admitting μ, α, and P' in StrictPBSCM with the degree-one-through-four signature equal to t; fiberAtSignature ignores all auxiliary coordinates outside that signature.

nl.statement: \(\mathsf A_{\mathrm{out}}\): combine interval screening of singleton, pair, and degree-four head coordinates with source-forest component enumeration, reverse-topological interval decoding, and certificate-preserving branch-and-bound for the target set \(\mathcal D_n\)

review.note: Neither direction is established: the paper defines a procedure combining specified computational stages, while Lean only predicates a one-input output/certificate tuple and permits a vacuous branch-and-bound trace starting at an already exact outer-fiber enumeration; conversely, Lean adds detailed finite rational interval and witness requirements absent from the frozen definition. Repair the frozen definition with an explicit quantified procedure/certificate contract before scaffolding its exact Lean counterpart.

nl.statement: For every \((G,\mu,\alpha,P)\in\mathcal M_d^\circ\) and every nonzero multi-index \(k\), the exact-support coefficient satisfies \(c_k=\sum_{i\in V}\mu_i\sum_{\gamma\in\Gamma_i(k)}w_\gamma\). The identity counts genealogical occurrences before observed labels are merged, so distinct downstream paths that repeat a vertex label contribute to the same exponent without cancellation.

review.note: After unfolding StrictPBSCM, logPGFCoeff, genealogiesWith, genealogyExpansion, multiplicity, and genealogyWeight, Lean states the same nonzero-coefficient identity over the strict model class; path-based genealogies preserve distinct occurrences while multiplicity merges only their terminal labels.

nl.statement: For every strict-model law \(P\), \(c_{e_i+e_j}>0\) if and only if \(\{i,j\}\in S(P)\). On every induced path \(i-k-j\), \(c_{e_i+e_j+e_k}=0\) if and only if \(i\to k\leftarrow j\). On every triangle, \(c_{e_i+e_j+2e_k}>0\) if and only if \(i\to k\leftarrow j\). Consequently \(A(P)\) is exactly the union of all arrows entering every vertex of indegree at least two in every member of \(\mathcal D(P)\).

review.note: After unfolding the coefficient, skeleton, fiber, DAG adjacency/immorality, parent-set, and compelled-arrow definitions, the four conjuncts faithfully express the pair, induced-path, triangle, and fiber-wide multi-parent-arrow characterizations; the distinctness conditions are intrinsic to graph edges and explicit where needed.

nl.statement: If \(u\) is a source of \(G\), \(\operatorname{Pa}_G(v)=\{u\}\), and \(u\to v\in E\), then \(\mathsf R_{u\to v}\) is acyclic, all transformed rates and thinning probabilities are strict, and its complete log-PGF equals \(\Psi_P\) identically, including the constant coefficient. The equality remains valid when \(u\) and \(v\) have arbitrarily overlapping descendant sets.

review.note: Lean encodes the covered source-edge flip and exact parameter transform, proves acyclicity and strictness on every transformed edge/rate, and equates the full MvPowerSeries (including its constant coefficient) for all qualifying DAGs without any descendant-disjointness premise.

nl.statement: For any \(G\in\mathcal D(P)\), the reverse-topological recursion in \(\theta_G(P)\) returns the unique \((\mu,\alpha)\in(0,\infty)^V\times(0,1)^{E(G)}\) inducing \(P\). Every denominator is positive, and the fixed-DAG coefficient map has full column rank throughout the strict parameter domain.

review.note: The four Lean conjuncts exactly express strict decoded induction of P, edge-coordinate uniqueness, positivity of the alpha denominators (with beta/mu denominator positivity following from decoded alpha_strict and decodeBeta_equation), and full column rank as injectivity of the derivative of the singleton/edge coefficient map throughout the strict domain.

nl.statement: For every \(P\) generated by \(\mathcal M_d^\circ\), \(F(P)\) is a forest, each connected component of \(F(P)\) contains at most one vertex of \(M(P)\), and \(\mathcal D(P)=\{G_\rho:\rho(T)\in T\text{ for every }T\in\mathcal T_0(P)\}\). A component meeting \(M(P)\) is directed away from its unique anchor, and each free component is independently directed away from its chosen root. This necessary-and-sufficient classification strictly strengthens the sufficient local orientation conclusions of Xiang et al. and Qiao et al.

review.note: After unfolding the referenced definitions, obsFiber P.Nonempty is equivalent to P having a strict PB-SCM representation; the conjuncts exactly state residual acyclicity, at-most-one anchor per component, equality with all independent free-component root completions, and orientation away from the unique anchor or chosen free root.

nl.statement: The exact fiber size is \(|\mathcal D(P)|=\prod_{T\in\mathcal T_0(P)}|T|\). An edge is compelled if and only if it does not lie in a free tree; its certificate is either a local head signature or the unique path from an anchor. Every free-tree edge admits both directions, certified by a finite sequence of maps \(\mathsf R_{u\to v}\).

review.note: The four Lean conjuncts exactly encode the fiber product cardinality, compelled-edge iff characterization over recovered skeleton edges, local-head-or-unique-anchor-path certificates, and two fiber orientations connected by a finite composable source-reversal chain; hd and hP make explicit the stated d≥2 strict-law domain.

nl.statement: For any two laws \(P,P'\) generated by \(\mathcal M_d^\circ\), \(t_4(P)=t_4(P')\) if and only if \(P=P'\). Equality of \(t_4\) also implies \(\mathcal D(P)=\mathcal D(P')\) and \(\theta_G(P)=\theta_G(P')\) for every compatible \(G\).

review.note: IsStrictLaw is exactly existential generation by the strict PB-SCM class; signature4 is the degree-one-through-four log-PGF coefficient restriction, and under its equality the Lean statement gives law equality, equality of the full strict DAG fibers, and equality of decodeParams for every DAG compatible with both laws, which is equivalent to compatibility with the common fiber.

nl.statement: The three strict triangle laws in the construction \(\text{def:triangle-witness}\) have identical \(\Psi_P(0)\) and identical \(c_k\) for every \(|k|\le3\), but their coefficients of \(z_s z_m z_r^2\) differ and their DAG fibers have different triangle sinks. Adding independent positive-Poisson coordinates extends the failure to every \(d\ge3\).

review.note: The three relabeled strict triangle extensions realize every finite dimension at least three, agree on the log-PGF constant and all coefficients through degree three, have fourth-degree values 1,0,0 at the stated monomial, and force the corresponding distinct sink in every nonempty observational fiber.

nl.statement: For every distribution \(P\) on \(\mathbb N_0^V\) with \(p_0>0\), \(T_k((p_x)_{x\in I_4})=c_k\) for \(1\le|k|\le4\), and \(\Pr_P\{t_4(P)\in C_n\}\ge1-\eta\). The inequality is finite-sample and uniform over \(\mathcal M_d^\circ\), without a lower bound on \(p_0\).

review.note: The Lean hypotheses encode a positive-size IID sample from an arbitrary count distribution with p₀>0, and its two conclusions are equivalent to the finite-map identity and simultaneous coverage; although coeffRegion uses total coefficient functions, restriction gives the paper event and every degree-four witness extends recursively through the triangular qₖ/q₀ term to a full-function witness, while consumers inspect only degrees one through four.

nl.statement: The outward inverse satisfies \(\Pr_P\{\mathcal D(P)\subseteq\mathcal D_n\}\ge1-\eta\) uniformly over \(\mathcal M_d^\circ\). If the reporting rule outputs no arrow when \(\mathcal D_n=\varnothing\) and otherwise reports only arrows present with the same orientation in every \(G\in\mathcal D_n\), then the unconditional probability that it reports any arrow not compelled throughout \(\mathcal D(P)\) is at most \(\eta\).

review.note: After unfolding obsFiber, outerFiber, fiberAtSignature, empiricalFromZ, and IsStrictLaw, the first conjunct is exactly uniform population-fiber coverage and hEmpty/hUnanimous yield exactly the stated unconditional false-compulsion bound; hp0 follows from the strict positive-Poisson SCM law and adds no model restriction.

nl.statement: Can \(\mathsf A_{\mathrm{out}}\) be constructed so that, for rational empirical cell frequencies and rational \(\eta\), it returns exactly \(\mathcal D_n\), emits a valid inclusion or exclusion certificate for every labeled DAG, terminates with delay polynomial in the input bit length and \(d\) between successive output source-forest classes, and preserves the coverage conclusion of \(\text{thm:outer-fiber-confidence}\)?

review.note: The closed non-Prop String preserves every stated input regime, exact-output and per-DAG certificate requirement, polynomial-delay criterion, and coverage-preservation desideratum, explicitly asserts no theorem, and is neither consumed by delivered declarations nor included in a theorem manifest.
